summary: Iter5 tested the new enterprise-BI upgrade (Command Center, Copilot suite, Agents, Automations, Integrations, Power BI stub, Floating Assistant). Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass (agents, command-center, copilot/analyze, copilot/detective, copilot/story, copilot/whatif, copilot/boardroom, chat/stream with CEO agent, integrations, powerbi/status, automations CRUD+toggle). Frontend: signup → /app renders all 8 KPI cards + 6 quick-launch tiles + floating-assistant; sidebar has 11 nav items; /app/integrations shows 13 connector cards with correct statuses, Power BI hero in 'Awaiting credentials' state with disabled Connect button; /app/automations create-form works, new rule appears in list; /app/chat has chat-agent-select with all 9 agents; copilot/detective/boardroom/whatif pages render their required inputs and buttons.

issues: board-export-pdf button is only rendered AFTER a briefing has been generated ({data && ...} wrapper, BoardroomPage.jsx L58). Spec asks to 'verify Export PDF button is present' — currently requires a full LLM run first. Consider always showing the button (disabled until data ready) so users know PDF export is available.

action_items: OPTIONAL: On BoardroomPage, render the Export PDF button always (disabled while !data) so the affordance is visible before the LLM run completes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1534 lines. The Copilot suite (~250 lines, 5 endpoints + shared _llm_json) is a natural extraction candidate into backend/routers/copilot.py; billing was flagged in iter4, this is a repeat.

_llm_json swallows all exceptions and silently returns the fallback dict — clients get a 200 with an empty analysis and no signal that the LLM failed. Consider surfacing an 'ai_available: false' flag or a 502 so the UI can show a retry state.

GET /api/command-center hashes user_id for deterministic KPI jitter (line 1324). That's fine for demo but the values are static per-user — a note or 'demo_mode: true' flag in the response would help future maintainers not mistake these for real metrics.
@app.on_event('startup') deprecation warning still present (carry-over from iter3/iter4) — migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all specified testids verified; Export PDF is behind data-gate by design)

test_credentials: Fresh signup per run (iter5_*@datamind.ai for backend, uitest_*@datamind.ai for UI).
seed_data_creation: 20-row iris CSV uploaded per session for Copilot/Detective/Story/Boardroom endpoints. One TEST_ automation created and deleted per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Enterprise-BI feature suite is stable end-to-end. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_enterprise_bi.py cover all 11 spec bullets. Only cosmetic follow-up: BoardroomPage.jsx conditionally hides Export PDF until a briefing exists. Prior iterations (auth, billing, EDA, ML, reports) unchanged and pass.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only a UX nit on Boardroom Export PDF visibility (rendered inside {data && ...}), documented above.
